name: TAIFEX option-chain Surface Method V0.1 research contract
parentSourceClass: TAIFEX historical/statistical option daily report for replay QA only unless strict first-known attestation exists.

quoteSelection.primaryPrice: mid=(bestBid+bestAsk)/2 only when bid>0, ask>0 and ask>=bid
quoteSelection.settlementUse: separate EOD comparison lane only; never silently mix settlement with bid/ask midpoint
quoteSelection.lastTradeUse: QA/context only unless a separate method version explicitly chooses it
quoteSelection.zeroBid: exclude from primary IV/surface fit; retain zeroBidFlag
quoteSelection.duplicateSeries: reject or require exact provenance/version resolution before fit

modelInputs.forwardPrimary: same-expiry futures or parity-derived forward under separately versioned method
modelInputs.riskFreeRate: official rate source with knownAt semantics
modelInputs.timeToExpiry: exact clock to contract settlement/expiry event
modelInputs.ivSolver: bounded root solve with option-price no-arbitrage bounds; failed solve => UNKNOWN

procedure: convert eligible options to implied variance under frozen model/input convention
use log-moneyness relative to frozen forward
fit/interpolate each expiry slice only inside clean observed strike convex hull
linear interpolation in total implied variance

methodB.role: secondary method-sensitivity comparison, not primary feature source until static-arbitrage checks pass
rules: same parent quotes as Method A
record fit failure and arbitrage state

staticArbitrageQA: option price within intrinsic/upper bounds under frozen convention
call-price monotonicity in strike on comparable expiry/forward state
strike convexity/butterfly consistency where data density permits
calendar consistency checked only on comparable moneyness/forward conventions
featureOrder: simple downside/upside skew and near/far term structure
IV-RV/VRP proxy after physical-volatility forecast is independently frozen
falsification: A complex surface feature is rejected/downgraded if its sign or rank changes materially between pre-specified reasonable Method A and Method B.
Surface feature must beat raw moneyness/DTE/OI/quote-quality/simple-skew baselines.
No factor is computed when quote coverage is too sparse; quality threshold will be frozen from source-only distribution before outcomes.
Historical EOD replay proves method stability only, not 18:10 PIT availability.
maturityImpact: No L3 promotion. Method identity is frozen but real raw-parent parser/readback and independent-date evidence remain pending.
